description: This file is a TypeScript source code for a test runner script that manages LLM autocompletion tests, including running tests, generating reports, and cleaning approvals.

classes.name: TestResult
classes.description: Interface defining the structure of test result objects used within the TestRunner class.

classes.name: TestRunner
classes.description: Class responsible for executing LLM autocompletion tests, managing results, and generating summaries.

methods.name: runTest
methods.description: Executes a single test case using a GhostProviderTester instance, handles approval checks, and returns a TestResult.

methods.name: isUnknownResult
methods.description: Determines if a test result is considered unknown based on approval status and output.

methods.name: runAllTests
methods.description: Runs all test cases, possibly multiple times, and outputs detailed results and summaries.

methods.name: printSummary
methods.description: Prints a summary of all test results, including pass/fail counts, category breakdowns, and strategy usage.

methods.name: runSingleTest
methods.description: Runs a specific test case multiple times and outputs detailed statistics and last run details.

methods.name: cleanApprovals
methods.description: Removes approval files for test cases that no longer exist in the test suite.
